authorization: User: OK, execute the next step after independent experiment audit.
purpose: Verify actual model-input rendering and native parser/Markdown delivery before fixing the next model candidate.

render_preflight.runtime: Docling 2.132.0 / Core 2.99.0 / Parse 7.22.3; existing isolated MLX environment; no MLX model load
render_preflight.pipeline: Actual VlmPipeline with dots_ocr preset and API-engine transport replaced by a fixed synthetic stub; socket networking forbidden
render_preflight.rationale: Ordinary formula/code control, real agent-wiki diagram page, and the two known renderer failures. This is diagnostic regression, not unseen quality scoring.
render_preflight.approval: Source-visible inspection of actual engine-input PNGs; approve by source hash/page/backend/options/actual pixels/full engine-input fingerprint. No universal dark-pixel rejection threshold.
render_preflight.scope_limit: Research-run input approval only; no per-ingest human-approval policy, semantic acceptance, or claim that Docling renders equal a future Paddle preprocessing pipeline.

delivery_preflight: Independent reviewers register and execute perfect-provider parser controls before evaluating saved model outputs; content, parser loss and Markdown representation are separate outcomes.
candidate_selection: One explicit next candidate with immutable model/source identities and official full-pipeline requirements; no model inference until its actual inputs and delivery path satisfy the preflight.
stop_policy: If perfect-provider inputs lose required formula/code content through the official delivery path, record that limitation; do not spend inference to hide parser failures or append case-specific text repairs.
